text: {"name":"wlan_peer_rx_rate_check","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns 2 for peer index 0xFF; otherwise checks the stored rate and, for parser-class-1 rates, whether its masked counter age is below the rate-specific threshold.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v3":"interface_context_base","v5":"stored_rate_code"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":316,"meaning":"Base of per-peer 16-bit counter or timestamp values, indexed by peer ID."},{"offset":453,"meaning":"Base of per-peer records with a 12-byte stride; the first byte stores the rate code."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Rate-table entry's 16-bit age threshold."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Rate-table entry pointer to a counter or timer object."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"16-bit counter or timestamp field in the referenced object."}]}
